cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Reveal the Truth in Layers
cards.instruction: Protect someone by disclosing the truth in stages, changing what each earlier statement appears to mean.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Dad's garden gnome is coming home. I've made little parcels like the restorer did.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She was wrapping her tools. Why does one gnome need several parcels?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, separate handling. The hat's in this one, and the feet are safe in another.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Is the face in pieces too? Dad painted that himself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The body broke, but his painted face is whole. Open that parcel first; we'll put the rest beside it.

reason: Replace unsupported confidence framing with a specific copied misconception that directs the Drive, retaining seed causality only where it remains understandable in the actual dialogue.
